input.quote: TrueLink agrees that the costs for any Hosting Services will not increase for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement and that rates charged for Hosting Services will not exceed that charged by TrueLink to any other party.
input.rationale: The only most-favoured-nation language in the Agreement runs in our favour: in § 6 (Documentation and Disputes, p0047) TrueLink undertakes that Hosting Services rates will not exceed those charged to any other party, plus a one-year price freeze. Searches for MFN-style formulations ("favorable", "best", "any other party", exclusivity) turned up no reciprocal obligation requiring Mortgage Logic.com to offer TrueLink terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match third-party offers, and the Compensation section (§ 5) imposes only ordinary fee-payment duties. This meets the preferred position (no MFN burdening Customer, Vendor-granted MFN welcome), so no redline is proposed.
